items.q: What does Category 5 mean on this page?
items.a: This page covers GTCFX UAE's marketing and introduction services only. No trading, investment or account-opening services are offered here.
Brands, partners, introducers and event organisers who want to reach a relevant audience in the UAE and the wider region.
Through targeted campaigns, content and events. Every lead is collected with clear consent and handled in line with applicable data-protection rules.

items.q: How soon can a campaign start?
items.a: It depends on the scope. We agree the timeline with you during planning, before anything goes live.
